therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: DNA alkylation by temozolomide combined with PARP inhibition by olaparib
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Synthetic lethality in MGMT hypermethylated tumors through impaired DNA repair
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: MGMT promoter hypermethylated advanced colorectal cancer

results.effect_size: ORR: 0% (0/9 patients with CR or PR)
safety_signals: Serious adverse event: nausea in 1/9 patients
results.dose_information: Temozolomide 75 mg/m2 orally days 1-7 every 3 weeks + Olaparib 150 mg orally twice daily days 1-21 in 21-day cycles

context.duration: Up to 1.5 years treatment, up to 2 years follow-up
